grammar.label: calibrating a claim — the hedge and boost scale
grammar.form: suggests / indicates / shows / demonstrates / proves; may / is likely to / will
grammar.meaning: matches the strength of the wording to the strength of the evidence

explanation.en: A claim has a strength, and so does every word used to make it. 'The data suggest' and 'the data prove' are not stylistic variants; they are different claims about the same data, and only one of them is usually honest. The C1 skill is to run a scale from 'may indicate' to 'establishes' and to stop at the point the evidence reaches.
explanation.uz: Har bir da'voning kuchi bor va uni ifodalovchi har bir so'zning ham. 'The data suggest' va 'the data prove' — uslubiy variant emas, bir xil ma'lumot haqida turli da'volar.

grammar.positive_example: The survey indicates a fall in attendance; it is too small to establish a cause.
grammar.negative_example: The survey proves a fall in attendance and establishes the cause.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek va rus akademik an'anasida qat'iyroq ifodalar qabul qilingan; ingliz tilida ular haddan tashqari da'vogar eshitiladi.

grammar.label: stance adverbials — frankly, curiously, mercifully, to be fair
grammar.form: sentence adverbial, usually initial, commenting on the whole clause
grammar.meaning: shows the writer's attitude to what the sentence says

explanation.en: 'Curiously, nobody checked' comments on the fact, not on the checking. These adverbials scope over the whole clause, which is why they sit at the front and take a comma. 'Hopefully' joined this class in the twentieth century and is still argued about; 'frankly' and 'to be fair' are now ordinary in formal speech but not in academic prose.
explanation.uz: 'Curiously, nobody checked' — butun faktga izoh, tekshirishga emas. Bu ravishlar butun gapga tegishli, shuning uchun gap boshida va verguldan keyin keladi.

grammar.positive_example: Mercifully, the second copy had been kept in a different building.
grammar.negative_example: The second copy had been kept mercifully in a different building.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida bunday izohlar alohida gap bilan beriladi; ingliz tilida bitta ravish kifoya.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Your conclusion says the survey proves the fall in attendance.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: The figures are eleven households. They indicate. They do not prove.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Is that not the same claim in weaker words?

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: It is a different claim. 'Indicates' says I have seen a sign. 'Proves' says nobody can now disagree.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Suggests, indicates, shows, demonstrates, establishes. Stop at the point your evidence reaches and not one word further.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: 'The survey indicates a fall; it is too small to establish a cause.'

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: That sentence will survive any reader you are likely to get.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: And the line about the missing file? I wrote 'curiously, nobody checked'.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: 'Curiously' comments on the whole fact, which is what you meant. Keep the comma.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: If I put it in the middle it modifies 'checked'.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: And then you would be saying they checked in a curious manner, which is a different accusation altogether.
